AVT McCormick Ingredients Private Limite.note: Incorporated as a 50:50 joint venture between A.V. Thomas Group and McCormick & Company in 1993.

Chukde Spices Private Limited.note: Chukde Spices operates as a brand under Lifestyle Foods Private Limited, which was founded in 2006 by Deepak, Rajat, and Vikram Luthra as a family-owned business and has never been acquired.

Dharampal Satyapal Foods Limited.note: The confectionery arm of the DS Group; in the process of merging the group's spice business (DS Spiceco) into it.

KBM Foods Pvt. Ltd..note: The business succeeded and acquired the assets of its predecessor partnership firm Karol Bagh Masala Suppliers Company in 2002.

Lifestyle Foods Pvt. Ltd..note: Operates as the family-owned parent company that launched and owns the Chukde Spices brand.

Munimji Foods & Spices.note: Operates as part of the promoter group associated with Pushp Brand Spices.

Orkla India Limited.note: Orkla India Limited operates as a major industrial investment holding company under Norway's Orkla ASA, following the merger and reorganization of its brands MTR and Eastern.

RMN Foods Pvt. Ltd..note: RMN Foods Pvt. Ltd. operates independently as the manufacturer, packer, and marketer of the Bhoj Masale brand.

SNN Foods Private Limited.note: SNN Foods Private Limited operates as an independent spice manufacturing company founded in Bangalore in 2020.

Shyam Dhani Industries Limited.note: Shyam Dhani Industries Limited operates independently under its founders and went public via an SME IPO on the NSE Emerge in December 2025.

Sunrise Foods Private Limited.note: ITC Limited acquired 100% of Sunrise Foods Private Limited in July 2020, and the company was subsequently amalgamated into ITC via NCLT approval in 2021.

Teju Masala.note: Teju Masala operates independently under JS Foods / J S Masala Company, serving the Karnataka and broader South India spice markets.
